connections: HB118: band bolts to clutch-shaft bracket. Handed bracket and precise mount unprinted; selected left SH953A plus shared carrier mount are hypotheses.

HB150-151: stop rod couples left clutch lever to bell crank, adjustable between nuts; eyebolt joins band, bell crank acts against spring. Wording has ambiguous antecedents; the constructed right-angle linkage is an engineering interpretation.
SNL193: four3/4in x1/2in-thick SH955D nuts; SNL125 SH955B nuts3/8in thick; SNL267 SH955A washer ID1/2 OD1-3/8 stock1/8.
SNL134/135: M4165 pin has5/8crownnut and5/32x1split; M4157 has1/8x7/8split; M4152 has1/8x1split.
Plate95 and museum side-brake photo depict a larger brake arrangement. Their profile is not dimensionally transferred into the small M858 stop band.
